balls.text: fitting end to the innings as Bravo gets his third. Overpitched outside off. Looks to clatter a six over long off. Slices it, and Raina at cover takes another. RCB finish on 156 for 6
full toss on off. Inside-out drive to cover. Just one for Wanindu
yorker attempted. Around leg stump. Drilled to long on for one. Not good enough for RCB
wide yorker, and lands inside the tramlines! Harshal looks to slice one behind square, but can't connect
full on leg stump. Misses the yorker, and Maxwell looks to smack a six over cow corner. But he checks the shot instead of offering a full flourish. Taken by the outfielder rather comfortably
wide yorker, leaves Maxwell on his knees. Full and wide from around the stumps. Maxwell can't slice a cut behind square
good length, outside off. Slapped to Raina at cover. Just four off the 19th.

drops safe this time. Length ball just outside off. Attempts the pull, and it's gone right up into the night sky. Should be caught out, but Chahar can't believe it. Gaikwad has not attacked the ball, and it has fallen well short of him. Did he not spot the ball early enough? Not confident to attack the ball?
knee high full toss around off stump. Muscles a shot down the ground, but just a single to long on
yorker length attempted. Ends up as a low full toss on leg stump. Drilled to long off for one
simply sensational! Good length ball on off stump, but its the legcutter. Tries to chip an inside out loft over cover but slices the shot. Raina reverse cups his hands, and takes an easy one

run out? Not a direct-hit at the bowler's end so Maxwell survives. This was a length ball punched to point. But David was not interested in the run. Bravo is excellent with the direct-hits so best to not take his arm on

top over ruined by the six! Only four runs in five balls but Maxwell was expecting the off-pace delivery. Stays deep in his crease as Bravo goes slow and full on off. Muscled over wide long on for six
tries to innovate. Ends up on all fours. Yorker length wide outside off. Tries to play a reverse paddle sweep past the keeper's right. Fail, on the bounce to the keeper

yorker attempted. Ends up as a dipping, low full toss. Whipped from middle stump to deep midwicket's right. Top throw from Jadeja in the deep, but Maxwell's running gear was on full tilt. Comfortably done
back of a length on leg stump. Still around the wicket. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket. Can he come back for two? No

attempts the wide yorker. Goes full and wide. Slices a shot towards cover. Raina runs to his left to dive and take a one-handed catch, but just fails! Fielder in the deep gets behind it. Tough chance. Full commitment from the IPL legend
around the stumps. Length ball on middle, and angling towards off. Tries to cut, but too close to the body. Past the edge to MSD

that's two in two! Back of a length on leg, so Padikkal goes low to ramp it over third man. However, it's a slower ball, the bounce doesn't rise as he expected, and has mistimed the shot. Doesn't go over Rayudu, who takes the catch inside the circle. Padikkal falls after a 50-ball innings at a strike-rate of 140.

sliced and Shardul gets the big wicket. Length ball, wider outside off. de Villiers backed away to the leg side so that he could go inside out over cover. But it was wider than he expected, mistimes the shot, and Raina takes the skyer at cover
back of a length just outside off. He shapes up to pull over midwicket but misses out.
bang bang bang! In the slot, around off stump. Clears the front leg and absolutely hammers a six over deep midwicket for six!
swings this one away into the deep midwicket region but no timing. Padikkal is tiring
squeezes this yorker-length delivery past the bowler
full outside off. Carves a drive in front of cover. Gaikwad has work to do from deep point, but slides across the ground to cut the four off. Time out
full and wide outside off. Slogs a drive to wide long off for one. Going deep in his crease beforehand since he knows Hazlewood is aiming for the yorker
swatted away! Full, in the slot just outside off. DDP clears the front leg and clubs it for six over long on.
good length on off and the cutter angles in. Looks to bunt it to the leg side, but misses out. Hits his body and rolls away to point

cheeky and nearly caught! Padikkal walks across to the off side before Hazlewood releases the ball. Paddles a low full toss to the leg side but not in perfect control. In the air, but just short of Rayudu at short fine leg
full toss wide outside off. Slaps a shot through to Chahar at deep backward point
slower ball, short ball. Padikkal looks to hammer a pull behind square, but mistimed due to lack of pace. Fielder in the deep cleans up
good length on off stump. Tucked away to midwicket for a single
yorker, just outside leg. He looks to flick it square but can't get bat on ball. Delivery thumps into his pad, and rolls away to square leg
good length ball on off. Tucked off the back foot to the gap at midwicket for a comfortable run
short and wide. AB backs away to cut, but ends up chopping the shot onto the pitch
full just outside off, and he creams a beautiful cover drive. But straight to Raina in that region
low full toss on off stump. Drilled to long on, but mistimed in the end
good length on middle, and a late nudge to short third man's left
edged? No, that's bat hitting the ground. Full and wide. Padikkal stretches out to play a square drive. No contact
starts off with a dipping slower ball that is nearly a yorker on middle stump. He flicks it to deep midwicket to get off the mark

short-arm jab straight to deep midwicket! Just beyond the slot length. Kohli looks to whip a flick over cow corner for six. But because it's a bit too full, he can't get the bat totally under it. Jadeja makes no mistake on the boundary line. Bravo with the breakthrough, Kohli falls victim to the nelson.
good length, wider outside off. Kohli looked to drag a sloggy shot through midwicket but missed out altogether. Bat also may have slipped out of his grip. Sweaty gloves?
good length on leg stump. Backs away and taps it away to cover point
yorker length, wider outside off. Clattered through to deep point. Jadeja won't mind the single one bit
full and wide ball. Darts one in. Padikkal tries to cut but the ball stays low. Grabbed by MSD
length ball on middle turning away. Pokes a cut to short third man
grip and turn! Length ball on leg and turning across over off stump! Kohli had no idea where that was going. Looked to poke at it but brought his bat back late
good length on middle stump from around the wickets. Nudges it behind off his pads, and this has been played fine! Rayudu can't cut it off from fine leg and that's fifty for Kohli!
good length just outside off stump. Smothered away to cover point off the front foot for one
back of a length, wide outside off. Drags a pull along the ground to deep midwicket. Fielder in the deep - Bravo - runs around
yorker attempted. Nearly in the block hole. Dug away to point from in front of off stump
full on middle. Wants to work it to midwicket but its been tapped back to Chahar instead
slower ball. Full just outside off and angling in. Nudged to short cover for a quick single
gets to fifty in style! His sixth in IPL. Chahar around the stumps. Short and wide delivery, a cutter off the hand. Cut firmly through the off side for four
quicker ball, full and wide. Bends his knees and cuts to Shardul at deep point
full outside leg, near his toes. Whipped off it to Chahar at deep backward square leg
good length outside off stump. Angling further away. Padikkal offers no shot thinking it will be a wide. Wrong call.
full, and very wide outside off. Reaches out and slaps a drive to deep extra cover. Fumble in the deep from Shardul allows them to take the extra run rather safely
good length on middle, and clipped off his waist to square leg
full outside leg, and clipped to midwicket
dug in short on middle and leg, Padikkal surprised by the short ball as he ducks under it
crosscourt forehand smash to wide long-on
wide yorker, dug out to deep point
slower length ball outside off, Padikkal uses the width to crash that into the gap. Delightful placement to beat sweeper point
steps out and tucks this towards midwicket
off the pad to short fine, leg bye
slices the drive to point
steps out and punches it into the gap at wide long-off
he's belted that way over long-on! Lovely use of the feet to get to the pitch and that Ganguly like swing through the line to clear the ropes
driven with the spin to long-off
dabs it to short third, didn't have the pace to work with. This spun back in sharply.  Wrong choice of shot
turns this towards square leg
leg-stump half-volley, picked to deep square
slower and fuller on middle and leg, he tucks this towards midwicket
steps out and turns this towards midwicket for a quick single
slower delivery but it's slipping down leg, Kohli misses the fine tickle and is cross with himself, wide called.
ah that bottom handed whip! Kohli fetches this full ball from outside off and smokes it into the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on
driven hard to deep cover
loopy slower ball that dips late as DDP pushes this into the off side
drifts in and gets it to turn a touch, Kohli solid in defence
fired full across the left-hander, eased to deep point
lands it a touch shorter, gets it to bite back in, Padikkal defends
cut hard, down to short third. Missed out on a rang long hop that time
belted up and over the bowler's head! Too full, Padikkal swung through like a golfer.
works it with the angle to deep square
excellent running! Bottom-edges one that rolls towards MSD, Padikkal was home in four strides
tucks this length delivery all along the ground to deep square
digs it short but down leg, wide called. Good short delivery though
runs it down to short third as they scamper a single
backs away and slaps this pull through midwicket! Bisected the gap perfectly.
steps out to pull but the ball zips through and Kohli can't time it.
steered down to third man
hits the hard length, Padikkal rises with the bounce as he fends it into the off side for a single
turns this wide of midwicket for a quick single
he's clobbered this into Abu Dhabi! Someone bring it back from the road, please. That blow over wide long-on will ring in Shardul's ears all night. Kohli didn't even bother looking at the ball.
pushed wide of cover as they complete a single
dabs it wide of Dhoni for a single on the off side
nearly drags one back on! Looking to step out and slap him over cover, but this one didn't skid on as fast as Kohli expected.
length and sliding down, flicked to deep square leg
toe-ends a pull back towards the bowler. Late on the pull
tucks it off his hip to fine leg
mistimes a pull to short midwicket
goes straight, clears the ropes! By no means a half-volley but DDP goes through with the stroke fearlessly. Arms flow in sync as he lifts it up and over.
beauty! Gets this to rear up awkwardly as Padikkal is beaten in trying to run it down
struck on the pad as he steps out, but is hit so high that MSD doesn't even bother paying any heed to Chahar's appeal.
steps out and wallops this wide of mid-on!  Kohli is in his zone today. It's a knuckleball, he steps out, gets underneath the length and picks it away beautifully
taps it gently into the cover region as they complete a quick single
spanked away! Too much width, DDP stays on the back foot and crashes that wide of extra cover.
full and moving back in a touch on middle, DDP shows the full face of the bat as he defends back
runs it down to third man
neatly tucked off his pads to long leg
slash and a miss! Had the width but the ball zipped through off the wicket
steps out and wallops the drive on the up through cover, looks like Moeen got his fingers on the ball to take the pace off.
toe-ends a defensive shot behind the wicket as they pinch a single. Man, they beat MSD to the single
bunts this down to third man
steps out to make room and slap that over cover, but ends up chopping it behind the wicket. Kohli didn't get width that time as Hazlewood hit the hard length on middle-and-off.
driven handsomely through the covers! Chahar overpitches once again in search of swing, Padikkal puts that away imperiously.
excellent leave! Padikkal leaves assuming this is going to leave him but this pitches outside off and just nips back in a touch. Ah, so close. Lovely delivery
full and moving across the left-hander, DDP lets this pass. Drivable length
width outside off, steered down to third man
flicked uppishly, this races away over midwicket! Back-to-back boundaries. Chahar goes full on middle, there's no swing at all, ends up being the perfect fodder for Kohli to whip that away
runs straightaway! Sprays a full ball down leg, all Kohli needed was a neat little tickle, put away easily.
good length, outside off. He mistimes a pull, goes high up in the air, but gets it just beyond Siraj running towards long on. Chennai Super Kings win by six wickets!
around the stumps, but very wayward. Full, and very wide down leg. Bharat's wicketkeeping saves the boundary. But tied scores
races away! Dhoni uses the pace to earn four more. Full on middle, angling down leg, and just helps it along its way for a boundary
full on middle stump. Wants to drive towards mid on but ends up playing it straight back to Siraj
length ball outside off and angling in. Pulls along the ground, but to midwicket now
good length, on off stump. He drills a pull square, and its hit far enough from Saini at cow corner! Hits the boundary skirting before the fielder could cut it off
back of a length delivery. Guides a checked pull to deep backward square leg
fullish outside off. Pushed to cover point, and a Kohli misfield allows Dhoni to comfortably take the single
Raina is hitting 'em well! Full on leg stump. Down on one knee and whipped over deep backward square leg for six! Two fielders in the deep over there but both are just audience
misfield! Good length just outside off. Flat-bats a shot off the back foot to wide long on. Lands just in front of Padikkal, but the ball bursts through his hands
good length, on leg stump. Nudged away to backward point for one
good length, on middle and leg. Turning into middle. Fended off the back foot. With soft hands
full toss on middle and leg as he skips down the ground. A controlled drive to long on
fullish, on middle stump. Bunted back towards Hasaranga off the front foot
yorker length on leg stump. Clipped to square leg for a single
starts off with a slower ball. Length delivery outside off but jagging into off and middle. Inside-edged onto his pads
pulled to midwicket! Another one for Harshal. Length ball outside off, and pulled in front of square. Straight to midwicket!
good length outside off stump. He comes down the track. Tries to cut. Misses
wide full toss and he slashes it hard! Gets enough to get it over short third man. Rayudu asks the square umpire if its a no-ball for height. Nope, legal ball.

good length outside off stump. Opens the bat's face and runs it to short third man. Chahal dives, but dives over it. Ball goes through him, and races away for four. Camera pans to Kohli, and he looks up
full outside off. Turning in as he skips down the ground for another big shot. Inside-edged onto his pads. Time out
vintage Raina! That will take you back to 2010. Full outside off stump. Turning further away, and he leans into a clubbed shot over cover. Beats the extra cover man in the deep!
full just outside off stump. Driven to mid on, which is vacant. One to the total
shouts of catch it but falls well short of the sweeper fielder on the extra cover boundary. Full outside off. Skips down the ground, has to reach at it. Bunts it over the infield
full just outside off. Bit of turn away. Defended towards point. Kohli runs across from first slip
full on middle and off. Turning away. Inside-out nudge past cover for one

Patel adds to his tally as the slower ball gets him a wicket. Full on his toes, Moeen looks to flick it over midwicket. But the 112kph ball gets him to play the shot too early, in the air, and Kohli gets under it at midwicket to take a simple one
back of a length, wider outside off. Walks across to the off side and plays a controlled pull to deep backward square leg. Saini is around there
good length wide outside off but angling in. Opens the bat's face to cut behind square
good length ball from around the stumps angles in sharply. Flicked off his hips to fine leg for one
fullish, wide-ish. Driven through the off side to the fielder in the deep
slower ball, wide outside off from around the stumps. Moeen has no risk as he looks to club a drive over cover. Sliced, but falls safe
back of a length, very wide delivery. Slapped to deep point for one. Front foot no ball
good length on off. Ball stays low while also turning in. Pushed off the back foot to long on
full outside leg stump. Turning into middle and leg. Moeen mistimes a reverse sweep to backward point for one
full just outside off stump. Flicked with the turn to deep midwicket. Big gap in front of square on the leg side
full on leg stump. Turning into middle. Goes inside his crease and tucks it off his pads to square leg
half-tracker on middle. Whipped off his pads - off the back foot - to deep backward square leg
music to our ears! Full on middle. Turning away from him, but Moeen is up for the challenge. Big stride forward, gets to the pitch of the ball, and smacks a six over deep midwicket!
that's deposited into the stands! Very nearly cleans the sponsor's car up too. Tossed up just outside off, uses the turn into him to go down on one knee and slog a shot away over long on
around the stumps. Length ball on middle. Whipped off the back foot to wide long on
over the stumps. Length ball wide outside off. Sharp turn in. Carefully cut to point
length ball outside off. Turning away. Cut to deep extra cover off the back foot
around the stumps. Full on leg stump. Looks to sweep. Misses, hits the front leg
Rayudu dances down the track. Full outside off and slogged with the turn to deep midwicket
full just outside off. Driven to long on for a single
good length ball on middle. Worked off his waist to square leg
inside out over long off! Full outside off. Turning further away. Opens the bat's face and lofts it over the fielder who was on the boundary line. Moeen "playing bold"
good length wide outside off. Turning even further away. Misses the cut, and wide given. Kohli wasn't too happy
flighted full on middle and leg. Driven down the ground to long on for a single
full on leg stump. Turning into middle this googly. Worked off his pads to square leg for one
fullish outside off. Stays on the back foot, and cuts ti point's right. They scurry across for one despite the throw to the keeper
shortish outside off, bunted between point and short third
turns this tossed up delivery to midwicket
squeezed into the leg side, wide of midwicket, for a quick single
tucked wide of midwicket
slog sweeps from outside off to beat wide long-on! Walked across early and walloped that away as he got to the ball

swept straight to short fine!  Are RCB finding their way back?  Extra bounce on this length delivery as Faf attempted a sweep. Got it high on the bat. Saini in taking the catch may have hurt his finger.
edged but Kohli moves swiftly to his right to stop that at slip.
beaten as he pokes at this ripping googly
attempts a slog sweep from outside off, but toe-ends it to midwicket
lunges forward and defends this tossed up delivery

that's a super catch from Kohli and he belts out a roar! Faf has asked Gaikwad to wait, and the umpires will go upstairs to check if it was a clean catch.  Soft signal is out.  And it will stay that way. Yuzi deceives Gaikwad in flight and turn as he attempts a drive, gets a thick edge and Kohli moving to his left from backward point then puts in a full-length dive forward to catch it superbly.
is there something this impressive youngster can't do? Reverse-sweeps Chahal over short third. Nonchalantly.
pulled to deep midwicket
gets a thick inside edge off a sweep, onto the pad and they get a single into the leg side
sharp turn that stops on Faf as he attempts to push at this, beaten
shortish outside off, punched to deep cover
lunges forward and pushes to cover
swept nicely down to fine leg, Saini comes around to cut that off but can't stop the second

Third umpire steps in to have a look at a run out appeal at the striker's end. Looks like Faf may be in. Yes, he is. RCB manufactured some artificial excitement there. Gaikwad pushed it to short third, by the time he looked up, Faf was up and away, and made it easily in time even as the throw came in from short third.
this is a flipper that has Gaikwad in knots, he's expecting turn but this one drifts in and skids through, awkwardly defended
driven to cover, good stop at extra cover
grip and turn from length on off, Gaikwad defends into the off side
works this down to long-on
eased with the spin to long-off
bhaaaaam! Kohli at mid-off barely moved by the time the ball had bulleted to the fence. It was hit that hard
gets besides the line and punches this length ball to extra cover
drilled down to mid-on for a quick single, Siraj with a diving stop
backs away, holds his shape and clatters this slower length ball over midwicket. Kohli already has a resigned look
slower bouncer, Faf picks it early and looks to pull but is beaten, played a tad too early
straight hit, wonderful hit. All the way.  Faf didn't bother moving after making contact as he backed away to swing.
chipped but rolls wide of mid-on
gets a thick inside edge as he looks to heave this slower delivery into the leg side, Bharat instinctively moves to his left to stop that on the bounce
punches straight to cover
slower delivery on off, this one rears up awkwardly to hit him on the glove, but they'll take a run as the ball rolls into the off side
walks across and swats this past mid-off! He certainly packs a punch when he hits them big. Walked across, waited, held his shape and then put away that slower delivery
oversteps! Oh, dear. Not good at all from RCB. Gaikwad simply bunted this length ball to short third and then heard the no-ball call.
full outside off, works it to deep midwicket
steps out and shovels this down the ground to clear long-on! What a lovely stroke. What hands, what feet movement. He continues to impress with every outing.
shortish and spinning away from outside off, pushed to point
wrong'un but Faf picks this off a length outside off, turned to square leg
shortish outside off, punched straight to cover point
wrong'un but too short, punched wide of point
ferocious sweep into the gap at square leg. That has raced away. Gaikwad fetched this full ball from outside off. Not premeditated though.
uppish checked on-drive to mid-on for a quick single
what wonderful timing! Wrists this incoming length ball into the gap at midwicket, Tim David with a diving stop at the ropes
slower ball that grips and bounces from length on middle, Faf takes his bottom hand off as he tucks it into the leg side. Looks like this rapped him on the glove
gets this to nip back in off the seam to hit him high on the pad as he tries to defend
short of length outside off, punched to cover
edged, but just short of short third man. Siraj gets this to move away late from off, Gaikwad gets a leading edge as he tries to work it to square leg
full toss on middle, he makes room to put that away but there's no timing, straight to cover
rolls his wrists nicely over the short ball as he fetches it from outside off to deep square
punches down to square third man as he opens the bat face
slower length ball on middle and leg, he tucks this gently to fine leg

scooped over short fine, carries all the way! As a bowler, Saini may wonder what he did wrong. Well, not much. Bowled full on off, hoping to get some nip away, but he saw Faf walk across, get down low and scoop him over. Ah, not a good feeling as a bowler.
right on the money - full on off, defended solidly
runs it down to third man again as they jog through
full and swinging away from outside off, Gaikwad runs it down to third man
short, wide and crashed through point. Gaikwad picked the length early and gave it a smack. Easy pickings.
uppish but behind point as he plays an airy drive, down to square third man
short of length on off, Faf defends into the off side
ah, lovely drive but a good stop by AB moving swiftly to his left
